prompt:
Anna: Your puppy has so much energy! Did you (say / tell) him to sit?
Ben: Yes, I did, and I always (speak / talk) to him in a calm voice when we practice.
Anna: That is smart. Everyone (says / tells) that young dogs need a lot of patience.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется tell + дополнение (him) + инфинитив; во втором — talk/speak to (говорить с кем-либо); в третьем — say + придаточное с that (без дополнения лица).

prompt: Attention all residents: several neighbors have (said / told) us that strangers are knocking on doors and asking for charity donations. Please note that our building committee has not (spoken / talked) with any fundraising group this month. If anyone asks for money, (say / tell) them to show an official badge first.
explanation_ru: В первом случае требуется прямое дополнение лица (told us); во втором оба глагола сочетаются с предлогом with в значении обсуждать/вести переговоры; в третьем используется конструкция tell + дополнение + to-инфинитив.

prompt:
Farmer: Good morning, Doctor. I need to (speak / talk) with you right away about a newborn calf that refuses to drink milk.
Vet: How long has this been happening? Did your worker (say / tell) you when it last ate?
Farmer: He (said / told) that it drank a little around midnight, but nothing since then.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске подходят оба глагола (speak/talk with); во втором после глагола стоит дополнение лица (you), поэтому нужен tell; в третьем дополнения нет, поэтому используется said that.

prompt:
Maya: Look at the board—the express train is delayed again. Did the announcer (say / tell) why it is late?
Liam: Not really, he just (said / told) us to wait on platform four.
Maya: Well, while we stand here, let's (speak / talk) about why a basic cup of coffee costs six dollars downtown now!
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске нет прямого дополнения лица, поэтому используется say; во втором используется модель tell + дополнение (us) + инфинитив; в третьем talk/speak about означает «поговорить о чём-либо».

prompt:
Clara: Sam! What a surprise seeing you by the travel books. I wanted to (speak / talk) to you about your new apartment!
Sam: Thanks, Clara! Moving was exhausting, to (say / tell) the truth, but I finally unpacked everything.
Clara: That's great. Let's grab a coffee later so you can (say / tell) me all about your plans for the weekend.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске talk/speak to someone about something; во втором — устойчивое выражение to tell the truth (честно говоря); в третьем — tell + дополнение (me).

prompt: During the parent workshop, our school dietitian (spoke / talked) for twenty minutes about packing healthy lunches without refined sugar. She (said / told) parents that simple whole foods keep children focused in class. Afterward, one father stood up and (said / told) a great story about a veggie wrap recipe his kids actually love.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске spoke/talked уместны для описания выступления с речью; во втором есть прямое дополнение лица (parents), поэтому требуется told; в третьем — устойчивое сочетание tell a story (рассказать историю).

prompt: At a press briefing this morning, the mayor (said / told) reporters that construction crews had uncovered a brick tunnel beneath the main market square. Historians have already (spoken / talked) about the discovery on local radio, calling it a rare glimpse into the city's past. The mayor (said / told) the tunnel will remain closed until engineers check its safety.
explanation_ru: В первом случае после глагола стоит дополнение (reporters), поэтому используется told; во втором — spoken/talked about (высказались/поговорили о находке); в третьем дополнения лица нет, поэтому нужен глагол said.

prompt:
Organizer: Hi Leo, our guest painter is stuck in highway traffic. Can you (speak / talk) to the crowd for twenty minutes until she arrives?
Leo: Sure, I can do that. Should I (say / tell) them the real reason for the delay?
Organizer: Yes, just (say / tell) that she will be here shortly and thank them for waiting.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске speak/talk to someone (выступить перед/поговорить с); во втором после глагола есть дополнение (them), поэтому нужен tell; в третьем дополнения нет, поэтому используется say that.

prompt:
Secretary: Good afternoon, Mr. Miller. I am calling to (say / tell) you that your son left his violin on the school bus.
Mr. Miller: Oh, thank you so much! Did the driver (say / tell) where the case is now?
Secretary: Yes, he (said / told) it is safe at the front desk in the main office.
explanation_ru: В первом случае есть дополнение лица (you), поэтому нужен глагол tell; во втором и третьем дополнение лица отсутствует, поэтому используется say.

prompt:
Nora: Uncle Ben, look through the telescope! Can you (say / tell) me what that bright moving light is?
Uncle Ben: Let me see. My astronomy professor once (said / told) that high weather balloons often look like comets at midnight.
Nora: Let's (speak / talk) about it at breakfast tomorrow—Dad won't believe what we saw!
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после глагола идёт дополнение (me), поэтому выбираем tell; во втором дополнения лица нет, поэтому нужен said; в третьем используется сочетание talk/speak about.

prompt:
Agent: Thank you for calling platform support. How can I help you today?
Caller: Someone stole my photo to make a fake profile, and I want to (speak / talk) to a specialist about removing it.
Agent: I understand. Please (say / tell) me the username of the fake account so I can block it right away.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске speak/talk to someone (поговорить со специалистом); во втором требуется глагол tell, так как сразу после него стоит дополнение лица (me).

prompt: While waiting at the airport check-in counter, Mrs. Green (spoke / talked) cheerfully to the clerk about her grandchildren's paintings. She pulled out her phone and (said / told) that her youngest grandson had just won first prize at school. Even the tired passengers behind her smiled when she (said / told) them a funny story about his messy art studio.
explanation_ru: В первом случае talked/spoke to someone about something; во втором после глагола нет дополнения лица, поэтому ставим said; в третьем — устойчивое выражение tell someone a story.

prompt: The department secretary handed Maya a sealed envelope and (said / told) her to open it right away. Inside was an official letter that (said / told) she had won a travel grant for summer research. Maya was so thrilled that she could barely (speak / talk) for a full minute.
explanation_ru: В первом случае используется конструкция tell + дополнение (her) + инфинитив; во втором письмо сообщает информацию без дополнения лица (said); в третьем передаётся физическая способность говорить (speak/talk).

prompt:
Mom: Good morning, Leo! Look outside—heavy snow blocked our front door overnight. The school principal just (said / told) all parents that classes are canceled today.
Leo: Awesome! Can I (speak / talk) to my friends online and invite them to build a snow fort later?
Mom: Sure, just (say / tell) them to dress warmly!
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после глагола идёт дополнение (all parents), поэтому нужен told; во втором — talk/speak to friends; в третьем — tell + дополнение (them) + инфинитив.

prompt:
Hostess: Good evening, Harbor Bistro. How may I assist you?
Guest: Hi, I have a 7:00 reservation for four on the terrace, and I am calling to (say / tell) you that our taxi is stuck in traffic.
Hostess: No problem at all. I will (speak / talk) to the terrace manager and ask him to hold your table for twenty minutes.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после глагола стоит дополнение лица (you), поэтому нужен глагол tell; во втором speak/talk to someone означает «поговорить с кем-либо».

prompt:
Tourist: Excuse me, who painted that giant blue cat on the bakery wall?
Guide: Well, I (spoke / talked) with the shop owner yesterday about this mural. He (said / told) that a local art student painted it last summer as a gift to the neighborhood.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске spoke/talked with someone about something; во втором после глагола нет дополнения лица, поэтому используется said that.

prompt:
Rachel: This rain won't stop! By the way, did your daughter (say / tell) you about next week's school science fair?
Hannah: Yes, she (said / told) she wants to build a model volcano.
Rachel: My son is doing a solar oven! Let's (speak / talk) more about their projects when we get inside.
explanation_ru: В первом случае есть прямое дополнение лица (you), поэтому нужен глагол tell; во втором дополнения лица нет, поэтому используется said; в третьем — talk/speak about.

prompt: During a visit to the local museum, a farmer showed the director an old clay coin he had found while planting olive trees. They (spoke / talked) for nearly an hour about the exact spot on the hill where he had dug it up. The director (said / told) the farmer that the coin could be over two thousand years old.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске talked/spoke about описывает обсуждение темы; во втором после глагола стоит дополнение лица (the farmer), поэтому используется told.

prompt:
Technician: I checked your tablet, and I have to (say / tell) you that liquid inside the charging port ruined the board.
Customer: Oh no! To (say / tell) the truth, I dropped it into a pot of soup while reading a recipe.
Technician: Always (say / tell) no to screens near the stove—it happens more often than you think!
explanation_ru: В первом случае после глагола есть дополнение лица (you), поэтому нужен tell; во втором — устойчивое выражение to tell the truth; в третьем — устойчивое сочетание say no (отказываться от чего-либо).

prompt: At the outdoor cafe in Rome, the tourist tried to ___ Italian to ask the waiter if the afternoon heatwave would end soon.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранным языком или общения на нём (speak Italian) всегда используется глагол speak без предлога.

prompt: A bright poster on the theater door ___ that auditions for the spring play will take place next Tuesday afternoon.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о тексте на плакате, вывеске или в объявлении («плакат гласит»), используется глагол say (The poster says that...).

prompt: The marine biologist called the shore office on a weak radio signal and had to ___ slowly so the crew could hear every word about the whales.
explanation_ru: Глагол speak используется, когда речь идёт о манере или скорости речи (speak slowly — говорить медленно).

prompt: Mark sent a quick message to ___ everyone not to click the strange link from their aunt's hacked account.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «велеть/попросить кого-либо (не) делать что-либо» используется модель tell + дополнение (everyone) + (not) to + глагол.

prompt: The email from headquarters tells that a sudden snowstorm will reach the mountain village tonight.
answer: The email from headquarters says that a sudden snowstorm will reach the mountain village tonight.
accepted_answers: The email from headquarters says that a sudden snowstorm will reach the mountain village tonight.
explanation_ru: Ошибка: глагол tell требует прямого дополнения лица (кому?). Когда речь идёт о содержании письма без указания адресата, используется says that.

prompt: The food blogger asked the baker if she could film him decorating the wedding cake for her channel.
answer: The food blogger asked the baker if she could film him decorating the wedding cake for her channel.
accepted_answers: The food blogger asked the baker if she could film him decorating the wedding cake for her channel.
explanation_ru: Предложение грамматически верно и не содержит ошибок.

prompt: After the lecture, the engineer and the librarian talked about old computers over paper cups of tea.
answer: After the lecture, the engineer and the librarian talked about old computers over paper cups of tea.
accepted_answers: After the lecture, the engineer and the librarian talked about old computers over paper cups of tea.
explanation_ru: Предложение грамматически верно: глагол talk корректно употреблён с предлогом about для обозначения темы беседы.

prompt: The support agent said the elderly caller to check the caps lock key on his keyboard.
answer: The support agent told the elderly caller to check the caps lock key on his keyboard.
accepted_answers: The support agent told the elderly caller to check the caps lock key on his keyboard.
explanation_ru: Ошибка: глагол say не используется в конструкции с дополнением лица и инфинитивом. Для передачи инструкции или просьбы используется tell someone to do something.
